The cards are incorporated into a PDF document for download and printing.

Cards are valid for a 30 day period after creation.
The patient can use the URL stated on the card where the 8 figure ID should be entered;

After entering the unique ID on the card and clicking submit, the patient is taken to an online version of the patient feedback form.

Alternatively, the patient can use the QR code on the card.

Scanning this code (for example on smartphone) will take the patient straight into the feedback questionnaire with no need for entering a unique ID.

With consent, the patient is emailed a link to a secure (encrypted) message.
A password, chosen by the patient is required to open (decrypt) this message.
The secure message includes details of how to access the patient questionnaire.
If they do not respond to the initial email, a reminder is sent at 10 days.
Patient email addresses are store in secure encrypted format temporarily.
Email addresses are deleted after the patient replies or after 10 days.
No personal details are contained in our emails.

The application also supports the scientific baby gender prediction method. It’s based on the scientific research by Rodrigo Guerrero and the statistics of thousands of women.

You can change the gender prediction method on the “Settings” screen. But remember that either gender prediction method shows only slightly higher chances of conceiving a girl or a boy and it never guarantees the result.

* Full Version *

This is the full version of the application. You will be able to see the following data:

- The probability of getting pregnant on the current or on any selected day.
- The probability of conceiving a girl or a boy using the selected gender prediction method.
- Chances of getting pregnant during the current period.
- Chances of conceiving a girl or a boy during the current period.

* How to Use *

To generate the menstrual calendar you have to provide the following data:

- The first day of the last cycle (select the day and use the button “Add”).
- Average length of the menstrual cycle (adjust it on the “Settings” screen).
- Length of the luteal phase (most women can use the default value).

The application works best for women with regular menstrual cycle. But average cycle length is also a good way to predict when the ovulation should happen.
